verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Fern Agent automations that run on a time-based schedule (fern-docs-8). It also shows Slack messages used to manually kick off agent PRs (fern-docs-45). Neither is a user-defined rule that fires an action automatically when an event occurs, so this is an adjacent capability. A recurring schedule is not an event trigger, and an on-demand chat invocation is not a rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
